entries.en: Good to see you again! Come by tomorrow for a proper chat.

entries.en: Welcome, neighbour! The feed came in fresh this morning.

entries.en: Your chickens look healthy, ma sha Allah.
You're one of my best customers now.
My father ran this shop for forty years - farmers like you kept it going.
entries.ar: أبوي فتح هالدكان أربعين سنة - مزارعين مثلك هم اللي خلّوه ماشي.

entries.en: You're family now. Anything you need, just ask.
entries.ar: صرت من الأهل. أي شي تبيه بس قول.

entries.en: Bring me good produce and I'll pay a fair price.
entries.ar: جب لي إنتاج زين وأعطيك سعر يرضيك.

entries.en: The hotels in Buraidah want fresh vegetables every week.
entries.ar: فنادق بريدة تبي خضار طازجة كل أسبوع.

entries.en: Your crops sell fast - I'll pay you a bit more.
entries.ar: محصولك ينباع بسرعة - بزيد لك شوي.

entries.en: During the date festival, everyone in Qassim comes to the market.
entries.ar: وقت مهرجان التمور كل أهل القصيم يجون السوق.

entries.en: I tell every buyer in Qassim about your farm!
entries.ar: أعلّم كل مشتري في القصيم عن مزرعتك!

entries.en: Salam! Still getting used to the heat? Water early in the morning.
entries.ar: السلام عليكم! للحين ما تعودت على الحر؟ اسقِ الصبح بدري.

entries.en: Rotate your wheat with onions - the soil will thank you.

entries.en: Here, my mother's recipe. Your dates will taste even better.
